description: This PHP script handles troubleshooting log downloads with access control, session validation, and file streaming capabilities. It initializes a CSRF protection library, verifies user login, retrieves request parameters, validates them, and streams the requested log file for download.

classes.name: csrfprotector_rdkb
classes.description: A class used for CSRF protection initialization.

methods.name: file_download
methods.description: Streams a file for download, supporting range requests, setting appropriate headers, and ensuring clean output buffering.
